audit.whatIsWrong: Lane difficulty is already framed correctly as an even skill matchup that tips to Swain at 4-6 and to Senna late.
audit.why: Both kits confirm it: Senna's ranged Q sustain/poke offsets early, Swain's E-P engage swings 4-6 and R closes at 6, then Senna's global R and crit souls out-scale.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3-6].side all read "Skill" while content win[3-6] already say Swain/Swain/Swain/Senna, and phases[6].why still argues Swain wins late even though win[6]=Senna.
audit.why: The packet levelChart (Skill,Skill,Skill,Swain,Swain,Swain,Senna) matches win[0-6] exactly; the full-layer side column is stale and self-contradicts the page.
audit.corrected: Move phases[3].side/phases[4].side/phases[5].side to Swain and phases[6].side to Senna, and rewrite phases[6].why to state Senna's late scaling instead of Swain anchoring.

audit.whatIsWrong: Senna's Q sustain (anti-heal timing) and her R shield absorbing burst are both flagged as applicable but unmentioned interactions.
audit.why: Piercing Darkness (Q) heals Senna on every poke, so Grievous Wounds timing matters in extended trades; Dawning Shadow (R) shields her side and changes all-in math if popped early.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes now tells the reader to force Dawning Shadow (R) before the level-6 commit; report[8] already carries the anti-heal note, corrected for gender.
